description: A Dockerfile with a build stage and a smaller runtime stage, so build tools and sources do not ship in the final image.
A Spring Boot jar extracted into layers, so rarely changing dependencies are cached separately from application code.
The ${NAME:?message} form, which makes Docker Compose stop with a message when a variable is not set.
An Actuator health group that tells the platform whether the application can accept traffic yet.
A unit of continuous integration that builds and tests one part of the system on every pull request.
A short written look back at what held up, what hurt and what to study next.
